chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"The religion will remain established as long as the Kaaba stands."

key_terms.الدِّينُ: the religion, meaning the divinely ordained way of Islam
key_terms.الْكَعْبَةُ: the Kaaba, the sacred House that serves as the central sanctuary of worship
key_terms.قَائِمًا: established, upheld, and remaining in force

ai.seo_question: How does the Kaaba relate to the continued establishment of the religion?
ai.summary: This hadith states that the religion remains established so long as the Kaaba stands. It highlights the enduring centrality of the Kaaba in preserving the outward standing and continuity of Islam, especially in relation to worship.
